title: Onboard astral-13b v1.0 — perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
description: Add astral-13b v1.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, performance profiles for common hardware targets, and automated changelog generation. Motivation: customers have requested a medium-sized 13B variant with good latency/cost tradeoffs; this PR registers the model, publishes per-device perf profiles (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, T4), and wires the changelog automation to include the new model in released notes. Changes include the metadata YAML, perf profile JSON, a minimal CI perf check, and an update to the changelog generator so onboarding events are emitted automatically. Checklist: [x] model metadata added and validated against schema ENG-1423, [x] perf harness run and profiles uploaded, [x] changelog automation integrated and smoke-tested, [x] docs page added with usage examples and recommended quantization profiles, [x] unit + integration CI green. Related: linear/ENG-1423, PM-88. See docs/models/astral.md for usage and suggested routing policies.
commits: initial: add astral metadata and manifest
perf: upload perf profiles for A100/H100/T4 and add summary

release_notes:
- Onboarded astral-13b v1.0: model added to registry with verified performance profiles for A100/H100/T4 and recommended quantization/Batching guidance.
- Changelog automation: onboarding events now surface in release notes automatically (see changelog-generator).
perf_profiles_summary: A100-80GB: 512-token median latency 120ms, p95 210ms, throughput 28 tokens/sec (batch=8)
H100-80GB: 512-token median latency 95ms, p95 180ms, throughput 38 tokens/sec (batch=8)
T4: 256-token median latency 420ms, p95 760ms, throughput 9 tokens/sec (batch=4)
Recommended quantization: ggml-4bit-sq; Recommended_batch_size: 8 for latency-sensitive, 16 for throughput-oriented workloads
automation_notes: Updated tools/changelog-generator.py to detect registry onboarding events by tag and generate structured release entries. Added unit tests and CI smoke step in scripts/ci/perf-check.yml to validate changelog payloads on PR. The automation will append a note to RELEASES.md when merge occurs.
